title: Townsend Brown born in Zanesville, built wireless telegraph as a boy

tellings.quote: was born in 1905. And there's there newspaper, you know, clippings of him creating, you know, wireless Telegram basically at the age of 12 or something.

plain: Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor later linked to research into electrically driven flight, was born in 1905 in Zanesville, Ohio, and as a boy of about 12 is said to have built a wireless telegraph, a device for sending messages by radio. Michels tells this himself, saying there are newspaper clippings from the time showing the boy's invention, as an early sign of Brown's unusual talent.
